decidingTermSampling.censusSource: outcome stream (every interior tick), not the year-boundary deployment ledger
decidingTermSampling.decidingTermSampleReason: warTerminationReads ride the pulse record and collapseIntervalHistory keeps only the year-final tick

channelCoverage.closed: filled — a reconstructed siege-abandoned outcome, or an open whose army is gone
channelCoverage.attackerId: filled — reconstructed from the outcome id prefix
channelCoverage.defenderId: filled — reconstructed from the outcome id prefix
channelCoverage.terminalOutcomes: filled — conquest and razing outcomes accumulated across every interior tick
channelCoverage.loserDied: filled — the defender save died flag
channelCoverage.treatyWritten: filled — the treaty ledger, keyed by the real treatyPairKey minter
channelCoverage.peaceReason: unfilled — no peace reason reaches the composed year result; warTermination publishes bands and a deciding term, not the reason token classifyWarEnding reads
channelCoverage.coalitionFragmented: unfilled — coalition fracture facts need coalitionLedgerEnabled, which no shipped preset lights
channelCoverage.seatTransitionFamily: unfilled — the WR-5 governed families need lineageClaimEnabled, which no shipped preset lights

sampling.censusSource: outcome stream (every interior tick), not the year-boundary deployment ledger
sampling.decidingTermSampleReason: warTerminationReads ride the pulse record and collapseIntervalHistory keeps only the year-final tick

claimBoundary.measured: An actual cold Node worker_threads round trip through the product advance worker module and domain entry.
claimBoundary.notMeasured: Browser Web Worker startup, scheduling, structured-clone implementation, or device-specific duration.
claimBoundary.residual: boundaryAndBootstrapResidual is an arithmetic remainder containing bootstrap, scheduling, clone, and delivery work; it is not exact transport time.
claimBoundary.timingClass: Host-sensitive release evidence and regression telemetry, not a cross-device performance guarantee.
